title: Normalized scalar comparison of DVR quotient completion and integral Roos completion
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell with integers R, an adic datum d on R, a scheme T, and the canonical coefficient model C of [def-sf-open-quotient-koszul-models]. For every P in the unbounded derived category of completed integral modules, there is an isomorphism from the completed-adic total derived limit of the strict quotient reduction tower of C(P) to C of IntegralOnSlice.completion(P) [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Composing the specified quotient completion unit with this isomorphism is exactly the scalar image under C.derived of IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit at P. Neither completeness of P nor a choice of generators for d.ideal is assumed.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative Q. Apply openDvrAugmentedTowerComparison to the normalized coefficient calculus. Its representative field gives a complex B of strict integral quotient towers, the augmentation a, and the simultaneous comparison with the recorded integral tower. Its unit field identifies the quotient completion unit with the scalar image of the actual sequence adjunction unit.

proof.text: The generic strictRoosDerivation computes total inverse limit by the signed Roos complex. Its universal right-derived comparison respects the ordinary inverse-limit comparison. Projection extensionality and the strict augmentation show that this comparison takes the constant/limit adjunct of a to the recorded zero-homotopy integral Roos unit. All equations are in the whole derived inverse limit; level projections are used only for ordinary limits and chain maps.

source.place: Tag 0941 (sites-cohomology-lemma-derived-limit-is-ok); normalized strict inverse-limit comparison under canonical coefficient transport.

proof.text: Compose the quotient-tower comparison, the inverse-limit comparison, and IntegralOnSlice.completionComparison. Its defining equation identifies the Roos unit with the specified integral completion unit. Naturality of both units transports this comparison from Q to arbitrary P. Exact scalar equivalence preserves the isomorphisms. No completeness or generator hypothesis is used.

theorem openDvrRoosCompletionComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (C : OpenDvrCoefficientModel l E d T)
    (P : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T)) :
    ∃ j : (completedAdicReduction T d ⋙ reconstructionRlim T d).obj
        (C.derived.functor.obj P) ≅
        C.derived.functor.obj ((IntegralOnSlice.completion l E T none).obj P),
      (reconstructionCompletionUnit T d).app (C.derived.functor.obj P) ≫ j.hom =
        C.derived.functor.map ((IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E T none).app P)
